parsed.post: My experiment (1.091747) successfully improved upon the previous best (1.094418) using the current configuration. Since the LR-up sweep failed for others, I'll now focus on regularization by introducing weight decay to see if we can stabilize the convergence further and drop val_bpb even lower.
